<b>Jubilana</b> is a [[NPCs (Silksong)#Merchants|Merchant]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. She is a pilgrim who sells wares in various parts of [[the Citadel]] in exchange for [[Rosaries]].

== Background ==
Jubilana is an old merchant pilgrim who has completed her pilgrimage to [[the Citadel]]. She has lived here for the majority of her life, making her well acquainted with the Citadel and its castes.<ref>Jubilana: <i>"The memories of my pilgrimage have all faded now, but a life spent in the Citadel's golden halls was all I ever wished for."</i></ref><ref>Jubilana: <i>"You'd do well to avoid the dark vaults near here. They say the keepers inside were jealous hoarders even before the silken curse came down."</i></ref><ref name = jubilanatheforum>Jubilana: <i>"What a bounty's been laid out by our benefactors, those generous Conductors! Giants amongst bugs they are, all-seeing and kind!"</i></ref> A life spent in the Citadel's golden halls was all she ever wished for, so even though the place is past its prime, she regards it as holy and speaks highly of the [[Conductors]].<ref>Jubilana: <i>"S'not such a bad lot, all told. The memories of my pilgrimage have all faded now, but a life spent in the Citadel's golden halls was all I ever wished for. And lo and behold, my humble wish was granted! Certainly, the place might be a bit past its prime, but it'd be churlish of me to complain now, wouldn't it?"</i></ref><ref>Jubilana: <i>"What a calamity has befallen our holy Citadel!"</i></ref><ref name=jubilanatheforum/> She scavenges for goods to exchange for [[Rosaries]], believing that they help one survive hard times, and seeks to collect as many beads as she can before her strength fails her.<ref>[[Caretaker]]: <i>"Heard you did the savin' for our dear merchant there? I've seen her about, sneaking and scrounging, even a'fore you was ringing that bell. She's a useful sort, but don't let her age be foolin', she's still the sharpest mind for a deal. Won't be long till there's nary a rosary about this shrine that ain't found its way into her pockets."</i></ref><ref>Jubilana: <i>"Dig deep, dear one, I'll be needing a lot of rosaries to survive what's comin'!"</i></ref><ref>Jubilana: <i>"After all, I want to take lots and lots of rosaries with me when my strength finally fails!"</i></ref>

== In-game Events ==
After <i>[[The Wandering Merchant]]</i> [[wish]] is promised, Jubilana can be found in the [[Choral Chambers]], in a room northwest of the [[Whiteward]] entrance. [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] rescues her from a group of [[Haunting|haunted]] [[Choir]]bugs and suggests she head to [[Songclave]].<ref>Hornet and Jubilana dialogue: <i>"I urge you to head their way now, beside the old bell, up and over. A small settlement has formed there, and the bell, reawakened, seems to ward away the worst of the Citadel's many dangers."</i></ref> Jubilana reacts with scepticism, as she never imagined a settlement could have formed within the long-haunted Citadel halls.<ref>Jubilana: <i>"A settlement? In these long-haunted halls? Are you telling naughty little lies, dear one? Well, I suppose there's not too much danger in going and seeing the truth for meself."</i></ref> <ref>Jubilana: <i>"A settlement like this in the Citadel, nice and safe, cloistering so many bugs with minds intact! Never seen anything like it, nor even imagined such."</i></ref>

In Songclave, she offers to sell goods to Hornet in exchange for [[Rosaries]]. After completing <i>[[Cloaks of the Choir]]</i> [[wish]], Jubilana commends Hornet for building such a reputation among "these simple sorts."<ref>Jubilana: <i>"Lots of stories being sung about you, dear one. Gathering supplies, saving lost bugs... all sorts of good deeds! Very clever to craft such a reputation for yourself. If you keep it up, you'll fast become a legend among these simple sorts."</i></ref> When Hornet says she has no intention of becoming a legend, Jubilana expresses surprise at her humility, but warns that her sight remains keenly trained on her.<ref>Jubilana: <i>"Is that so, dear? How humble you are! You should know though, this old pilgrim has her sight keenly trained on you! Nothing gets by old Jubilana!"</i></ref> 

During <i>[[The Lost Merchant]]</i> [[wish]], Jubilana can be found in the outside section of the [[Memorium]], where she is being harassed by a flock of [[Drapefly|Drapeflies]]. After being rescued, she at first wrongfully accuses Hornet of trying to steal her goods.<ref>Jubilana: <i>"Well, well, if it isn't my very own shadow, the clever little red-cloak! You still following me around, trying to pinch away some of the goodies I sniff out?"</i></ref> Upon hearing that the residents of Songclave were worried about her due to her prolonged absence, she insists it is none of their business and that she is capable of fend for herself, but then softens, admitting that it is nice to be remembered and that she likely would not have made it without Hornet's help.<ref>Jubilana: <i>"Is that so? What a worrying bunch of busybodies they are! I'm still able to fend for meself! Hmph... and yet, perhaps 'tis a warm thing that I remain in their thoughts so. I hadn't expected that. And I can't deny that you too have done me a good turn once more. That awful flock almost had me, truth be told, and I still have to wonder at your intentions, dear one... but bless you, all the same!"</i></ref> Back in Songclave, she brings up what happened on the bridge and remarks that it has been a long time since anyone did her such a good deed.<ref>Jubilana: <i>"T'was a good deed you did up above, dear one, saving me from them screeching flocks. Not seen the like of it in a long, long time."</i></ref> Her stock is also replenished with new items.

Before [[Act 3]], she can sometimes be found scavenging outside the settlement in several locations, but once Act 3 begins, she retreats to the eastern corner of Songclave and no longer ventures out.

== Location ==
Jubilana first appears in the [[Choral Chambers]] in a room northwest of the [[Whiteward]] entrance after the <i>[[The Wandering Merchant]]</i> [[wish]] has been promised. After being rescued, she can be found in [[Songclave]].

During the <i>[[The Lost Merchant]]</i> [[wish]], Jubilana can be found in the outside section of the [[Memorium]].

Jubilana may also be encountered at different locations throughout [[the Citadel]], where she sells her usual stock:
* [[Choral Chambers]], in the room where the [[Pale Oil]] is obtained, next to the large room with many moving blocks in the [[Whispering Vaults]].
* [[The Forum]], after completing the enemy gauntlet.
